title: First Completed Preparation Frame
statement: For any Boolean words $w,s$, there is a natural number $t$ with $0<t\le 5(|s|+|w|+3)$ such that the preparation machine, started from its initial frame, does not visit phase $8$ at any time $j<t$, and at time $t$ has candidate $s$ on its first tape, an empty second tape, the suffix of $w$ after its first $|s|$ symbols on its third tape, all work heads and the input head at their specified initial positions, and overflow flag equal to the truth value of $|w|<|s|$.
hypotheses_covered: No visit to phase $8$ at any time $j<t$
At time $t$, first tape contains $s$, second tape is empty, third tape contains the suffix after $|s|$ symbols, heads are at the specified positions, and overflow records $|w|<|s|$
replaced:
For any input $w$ and candidate $s$, there is a time $t$ with
$0 < t \le 5(\abs{s} + \abs{w} + 3)$ such that the preparation machine never
visits its return phase before $t$ and at time $t$ sits in its completed
frame with the candidate and native suffix prepared; positivity holds even
for empty input and an empty candidate.
